name: Display hook (PC → Goggles)
description: Loads the display/overlay hook required by the PC → Goggles hardware tunnel. The tunnel owns the video plane; the hook is kept loaded so the fork child can open extra_blending.
notes: Required by PC → Goggles. The legacy fb_shared JPEG injection is not used by the app. If the screen stays black, use Recover stock UI or reboot.
